name: admin-fullstack-starter
description: Vue 3 + NestJS 后台管理系统全栈基础模板（类 Monorepo：web / backend 独立依赖，根目录统一编排）

scripts.install:all: pnpm run install:web && pnpm run install:backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,backend -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:backend
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:check: pnpm run lint:check:web && pnpm run lint:check:backend
scripts.format: pnpm run format:web && pnpm run format:backend
scripts.format:check: pnpm run format:check:web && pnpm run format:check:backend
